title: Security Deposit Kinds, Rate Schedules and Triggering Events
content:
Lakeshore Power & Light Company assesses a Security Deposit under one of six kinds. The kind follows the customer class of record and the rate schedule of the service agreement, and each kind is assessed only on the triggering events marked for it below.

## Schedule of kinds

| Security Deposit kind | Customer class | Rate schedules | Residential agreements only |
|---|---|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | Residential | Schedules RS, RT and REV | Yes |
| Residential Reestablishment Deposit | Residential | Schedules RS, RT and REV | Yes |
| Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit | Residential | Schedules RS, RT and REV | Yes |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | Business | Schedules GS and GST | No |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | Business | Schedule GD | No |
| Large Power Service Deposit | Business | Schedule LP | No |

## Triggering events and timing terms

| Security Deposit kind | New agreement opened without a waiver basis | Disconnection for nonpayment of the agreement | Late payment charges within 12 months that allow a deposit on an existing agreement | Confirmed meter tampering or diversion finding required | Assessment window (calendar days after the triggering event) | Deposit fully secured before a new agreement is energized | First installment received before a disconnected agreement is reconnected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | Triggers | Does not trigger | 0 | No | 30 | No | No |
| Residential Reestablishment Deposit | Does not trigger | Triggers | 3 | No | 30 | No | Yes |
| Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit | Does not trigger | Does not trigger | 0 | Yes | 60 | No | Yes |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | Triggers | Triggers | 2 | No | 30 | No | Yes |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | Triggers | Triggers | 2 | No | 30 | No | Yes |
| Large Power Service Deposit | Triggers | Triggers | 2 | No | 30 | Yes | Yes |

Notes to the schedule:

1. A late payment count of 0 means late payments are not a trigger for that kind.
2. The assessment window is the number of calendar days after the triggering event within which the deposit may be assessed.
3. "Fully secured before energization" states whether the Security Deposit must be fully secured before a new service agreement of that kind is energized.
4. "First installment before reconnection" states whether the first installment must be paid before a disconnected agreement of that kind is reconnected.

## Reading the schedule

- **A residential agreement on Schedule RT that has been disconnected for nonpayment** falls under the Residential Reestablishment Deposit, the only residential kind for which disconnection is a triggering event.
- **A residential agreement with late payment charges** can be assessed only under the Residential Reestablishment Deposit, at a count of 3; the other two residential kinds show 0.
- **A business agreement on Schedule GD** falls under the Medium Commercial Service Deposit; a new agreement, a disconnection for nonpayment or a count of 2 late payment charges within 12 months are each a triggering event for it.
- **The Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit** has the longest assessment window, 60 calendar days, and is assessed only on a confirmed tampering or diversion finding.
- **Only the Large Power Service Deposit** must be fully secured before a new agreement is energized.
